q: How often do you use the Internet?
a: I use the Internet every day. I check my emails and my social media accounts early in the morning. And I often watch videos, listen to music and chat with my friends on the Internet at night.

q: What do you use your computer for?
a: I use my computer for a variety of things, such as doing research, watching videos, listening to music and writing emails. Sometimes I also play games on my computer.

q: What are some problems that using computers may cause?
a: The main problem is people tend to develop an inactive lifestyle if they spend too much time on their computers. Another problem is our personal information may be stolen if our computers are infected with viruses.
vocab: develop an inactive lifestyle / develop a sedentary lifestyle
形成缺少运动锻炼的生活方式

q: Do you prefer to write by hand or type on a computer?
a: It depends on the situation. I usually prefer to type on a computer because typing is faster than writing by hand, and I can copy, paste or save what I have typed on a computer. But when I need to take notes or make a shopping list, I prefer to write them by hand.

q: Which do you think are better for communicating with others, emails or hand-written letters?
a: It depends on the situation. Emails are usually better because they arrive immediately. But I suppose hand-written letters are better when we want to express love or appreciation because hand-written letters feel more personal than emails.

q: Do you prefer to send a text message or make a phone call?
a: It depends on the situation. I usually prefer to send a text message because it's faster and cheaper than making a phone call. But when I need to have a long conversation or when I need to talk about an urgent matter, I prefer to make a phone call.

q: Which are more popular among mobile phone users in your country, mobile apps or websites?
a: Mobile apps are more popular in my country. It's easier and more convenient to use mobile apps than to browse websites. Well-designed mobile apps also perform tasks faster than websites.
vocab: 方便使用的，用户友好的

q: What are some benefits of playing video games?
a: I suppose the main benefit is that playing video games can improve hand-eye coordination. Some video games also help players improve their problem-solving skills and teamwork skills.
vocab: 增强手和眼的协调能力
copy what they see in video games
模仿他们在电子游戏里看到的内容

q: Do you like robots that can do the housework?
a: Yes, I do because they are easy to use and easy to store. And they can help us save time and energy.
vocab: easy to use and easy to store

q: Do you like the idea of robots driving our cars?
a: That's a good idea because robots don't get tired like humans. I suppose driving, especially long-distance driving, would be much safer if cars were controlled by robots.

q: What types of music do you like?
a: My favourite type of music is classical music because it makes me feel calm and relaxed. I'm also fond of R&B, or rhythm and blues, because listening to it helps me reduce stress.
vocab: make me feel calm and relaxed
让我感觉心情平静而且放松
make me feel calm and peaceful
（近义）让我感觉心情平静而且平和

q: What's the difference between the music that you like listening to nowadays and the music that you liked listening to as a child?
a: As a child, I was fond of listening to happy and energetic music. Nowadays, I like listening to music that is calm and relaxing.

q: Do you prefer to buy music CDs or download music from the Internet?
a: I prefer to download music from the Internet so that I can have a wider variety of music to choose from. It's also more convenient than buying CDs from music shops.
